senses.gloss: m. (בלי, formed like בזיונא) [destruction,] a cacophem. for idolatrous phylactery, amulet (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Amuletum). ב׳ דגושפנקא (Ar. בילוניא) an amulet (stone) set in a ring.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 57a:9">Gitt. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>עד דמתחזי ב׳ וכ׳</he> so that the stone of a ring could be distinguished (as to shape, legend &c.) at a distance of a mile (from the illuminated town).

<cite ref="Gittin 58a:5">Ib. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>נקטי ב׳ וכ׳</he> (Yalk. Lam. 1242 <cite ref="K00551"><he>כיליינא</he></cite>, <cite ref="K00270"><he>כול׳</he></cite>) they took an amulet (believed to effect the begetting of healthy and handsome children).
